text: 'Partners need self-service' isn't a requirement yet -- it has to get precise before anyone can design against it.
Every partner must create and check their own claims through the portal AND through a Scripted REST API -- the API counts from day one.
And a partner must never see another partner's claims, through either path -- not just the one that's easiest to demo.
Zara Ahmed, Technical Architect, flags that an ACL proven on the portal doesn't prove the API is safe too -- both get checked.
Next: scoping V1 honestly -- what actually ships, and what gets deferred.
